page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Large title block at top centre in capitals; a woodcut emblem with a circular inscription in the middle; printer's imprint at the foot. No margin text. A digitiser's banner at bottom right is left out.

page.notes: Title page with a woodcut emblem (oval inscribed medallion with a central figure, between ornamental scrollwork) between the title block and the imprint. The title block is set in large capitals and some lines are printed upside down or mirrored in the scan (show-through from the reverse); the readings above are best reconstructions of the printed lines and several words are doubtful, notably in the Latin lines of the second and third blocks. The last line of the imprint is partly illegible in the scan. Several words in the body block are therefore uncertain and should be checked against the original.
